messages:
Sofia: quick note before rehearsal tomorrow 9:30 PT — new runbook attached. main asks: confirm fallback cue, who watches chat, and CRM field mapping. please skim. :spiral_calendar:

Sofia: proposed run-of-show (short):
- 0:00 open + objectives (Sofia)
- 2:30 benchmark narrative: unit economics and latency SLAs (Ravi)
- 8:00 demo: force hosted latency -> auto-fail to dedicated, show traffic shift (Cal)
- 17:00 audience q&a + CTA -> short CRM capture (Lina)
- 24:00 closing 

Cal: demo plan notes — we'll inject a 200ms delay to the hosted endpoint to surface p95 breaches. primary route = live-hosted (redwood/v1-small); fallback route = live-dedicated (redwood/v1-medium-q). We'll flip via the admin API and surface logs in the dashboard so audience sees the switch.

Ravi: I will make a one-slide explainer for the audience on "why choose quantized variants" with two bullets (cost per token, throughput). Add a small footnote about small output variance. Keep it non-technical.

Lina: CRM mapping: crm_source = "mar_launch_webinar", crm_interest_bucket = "hosting:dedi:private", hidden field demo_model = "variant_in_demo". I will also add a hidden utm param utm_campaign=mar_launch_2026 for panelist links so we can attribute signups.

Sofia: chat coverage — we need 2 people. Lina can own lead triage and link drops; Sofia will handle product/SLA Qs. Can someone own pricing quick replies?

Lina: I'll prepare canned replies for pricing, Dedicated SLAs, and POC contact link. Will upload to rehearsal folder.

Cal: rehearsal run commands for stage manager (demo VM uses DEMO_TOKEN env var):

```
# force fallback to dedicated (shows routing change & preserves session if compatible)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/admin/route-switch -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"route":"live-route","target":"redwood/v1-medium-q","tag":"demo_fallback"}'
```

```
# reset to hosted primary
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/admin/route-switch -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"route":"live-route","target":"redwood/v1-small","tag":"demo_reset"}'
```

Cal: note — the dedicated pre-warm must run ~6m prior. OpsBot, can you schedule that?

OpsBot: action scheduled: prewarm dedicated pool for live-route at 2026-03-24T09:24:00Z (requested by Cal). :white_check_mark:

Ravi: small detail — quantized medium occasionally shortens output on edge tokens. we'll pick prompts that avoid boundary cases (no long creative completions). Add a visual caption: "Demo uses short Q&A prompts to keep outputs stable."

Sofia: accessibility + recording — captions on, start recording 9:25 PT. Lina, can you ensure the CRM form has the hidden model_variant field and test submission before go-live?

Lina: will test now and upload test submission screenshot to the rehearsal folder. link: https://redwood.share/rehearsal/mar_launch_assets

Cal: final rehearsal checklist for greenroom:
- VPN & mic check (all)
- Prewarm dedicated (ops)
- Short-lived demo token scoped to route-switch only (security)
- Recording + captions enabled (Lina)
- Slide deck: add 1-line benchmark caveat (Ravi)

Sofia: please be in greenroom 9:10 PT. rehearsal starts 9:30 PT sharp. I'll paste the runbook into the doc and pin it. Thanks! :rocket:
